title: Eleven Pages and One Ribbon
subtitle: 复制与副本 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 复制与副本（科学与技术·信息与复制）
meta: 主题语境：复制与副本（科学与技术·信息与复制）　|　核心词汇：copy　|　正文 329 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 copy 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 my aunt ① made a copy of a letter she was not allowed to keep, and she said the making was the whole of the returning. The ② copy, meaning the duplicate and not the original, ran to eleven pages and stayed that length; copy, she said, is the only thing in a hand that is judged by how little it differs.

Every ③ copy in that office had the same ribbon, and the ④ copy at the end, meaning the one she kept for herself and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever read twice. Copy, my mother said, is nine parts ribbon and one part somebody willing to press; my aunt said the pressing is the part that fills eleven pages.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the copy was the whole of the advertisement, meaning the wording and not the duplicate. The ⑥ copy, meaning the wording and not any of that, is the only thing in an advertisement that everybody reads and nobody calls words; copy, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a duplicate and a wording. She said the wording is the part they remember.

By 1967 the ⑦ copy had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the ribbon. The ⑧ copy of the whole thing, my aunt wrote in April, was one letter and thirty years of pressing; copy, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to check. He said the checking was never mentioned.

The ⑨ copy I remember is the one at the end, which she made in 1973 and is still described as the faintest in the county. A ⑩ copy, my mother said in 1975, is the only thing that improves by being checked; every copy, she said, is a wording that has agreed to look like a duplicate. She said the wording was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 副本（指那份复制件本身，与那封原件相对）
C. 固定搭配：make a copy of 复制一份……
D. n. 复印件（指那间办公室里每一份）
E. n. 复印件（指末尾那一份）
F. n. 文案；文字稿（广告文案的用语）
G. n. 副本（指登记簿里提到的那一份）
H. n. 抄本；复制件（抽象总称）

items.q: made a copy of a letter she was not allowed to keep
The copy, meaning the duplicate and not the original
the copy was the whole of the advertisement
the copy had become a line in a register
The copy of the whole thing

answers.why: make a copy of 意为“复制一份……”，1959 年姑姑复制了一封她不被允许留下的信。
copy 意为“副本”，指那份复制件本身而不是那封原件，有十一页。
copy 指那间办公室里每一份复印件，每一份都出自同一条色带。
copy 指末尾那一份（她自己留的那一份），是唯一有人读过两次的。
copy 意为“文案、文字稿”，父亲说文案就是那则广告的全部，指的是广告文字而不是那份复印件。
copy 为另一个义项，指广告的文字稿而不是那份复印件，是广告里人人都读、却无人称之为文字的东西。
copy 意为“副本”，指登记簿里提到的那一份，到 1967 年这份副本成了登记簿里的一行。
copy 意为“抄本、复制件”，姑姑四月写道，整件事的复制件是一封信三十年的按压。
copy 意为“副本、复印件”，我记得的是末尾那一份，她 1973 年复制的，至今仍被说成全县最淡的。
copy 为抽象总称，母亲说一份副本是唯一会因为被核对而变好的东西。
